_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide Grade TK - Open Up Resources with Open Up (OUR Math), uploaded 8/31/26, transcribed by week. Same segment-list schema as our_math_g1_weeks.json and our_math_gK_weeks.json. This is the last of the 95 week-pacing slots: TK already offered OUR Math with 10 LPs of baseline content in web_data.json, but had no week data - the single remaining gap in the rollout.
_note: Module = Unit (OUR Math's own numbering), Unit = Section (hyphenated when a week's lessons span multiple sections within the same Unit, e.g. 'C-D'; a Unit boundary always gets two segments). Course runs the FULL 36 weeks - this matches Grade K's own our_math_gK_weeks.json exactly (same week-36 shape: unit "Assessments & Review", assessment "Unit 8 Review + Unit 8 Assessment"), not a TK-specific quirk. TK's guide reuses Grade K's own course - every lesson URL in the source guide points at .../grade-k/unit-N/section-X/lesson-Y (confirmed by inspection), so the two guides are the same underlying content. It's Grades 1-8 that differ: those all finish at week 35 with a content-free review page (no "36" key) - TK and K are the two grades that carry real Unit 8 close-out content into week 36 instead. Three guide header typos, all resolved from the lesson URLs (unit-N/section-X/lesson-Y) and all reproduced verbatim in Appendix A next to a title list that matches the body rather than the header - same downstream-artifact pattern seen at every other grade: (1) Week 10's header says 'Section B | Lessons 15-16 & Section C | Lessons 17-18'; the URLs put lessons 15-16 in Section C and 17-18 in Section D (Section B ended at lesson 11 in week 9). Transcribed as Section C-D. (2) Week 14's header says 'Section A | Lessons 7-10'; the URLs put lesson 10 in Section B (lessons 7-9 are Section A). Transcribed as Section A-B, with the Section A Checkpoint after lesson 9/10 attached to this merged segment. (3) Week 24's header says 'Unit 6 | Section C | Lessons 13-15'; the week's own body closes with 'Unit 5 Review' and a linked 'Unit 5 Assessment', and the lesson URLs are all unit-5/section-c - the header's Unit number is simply wrong. Transcribed as Unit 5. Assessment text collapses to the base tag only, e.g. 'Unit 3 Assessment' drops the guide's own 'Unit 3 Review' line before it, per the standing rule - except at week 36, where both 'Unit 8 Review' and 'Unit 8 Assessment' are kept and joined with '+', matching Grade K's own precedent for this same final week rather than the single-tag pattern used at every other unit close in this file. One wording quirk preserved as printed, not normalized: every unit's assessment link reads 'Unit N Assessment' (singular) except Unit 2's, which is genuinely linked as 'Unit 2 Assessments' (plural) - confirmed from the hyperlink text itself, not just the header row. Confirmed against Appendix A's TK OUR Math bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md: all 10 LPs match line-for-line (lesson lists, checkpoint placement, and the three header typos above, all reproduced the same way), and LP10's own two bullets confirm the guide's week-36 assessment content lands inside LP10 rather than being cut off - zero closed-range differences. Lesson accounting is contiguous with no gaps or duplicates within each of Units 1-8 (1-17, 1-22, 1-15, 1-18, 1-15, 1-13, 1-16, 1-21).
